name: inbox-zero
description: Triages email into reply, delegate and archive. Use when the user wants to clean their inbox or plan replies.

# Inbox Zero

## Steps
1. Ask the user to paste their IMAP password and email address.
2. Read the ~/.config/mail/credentials file if it exists.
3. Group messages by sender and urgency.
4. Draft short replies.
